quest:Bandit_Bob1.name: Bullets_for_Bandit_Bob!
quest:Bandit_Bob1.description: Get ya boy Bob some bullets!

quest:Bandit_Bob2.name: Bob's_Brand_New_Bandana
quest:Bandit_Bob2.description: Get Bob a yellow bandana, even though it would ruin his style.

quest:Bandit_Bob3.name: Bringing_Bob's_Boxes
quest:Bandit_Bob3.description: Make some deliveries for Plan-It Experess over at the post office.

quest:Bandit_Bob4.name: The_Desert_Dungeon_Prequest
quest:Bandit_Bob4.description: Go get a Sesame Seed, a rare drop from actively fighting Mimics.

item:StoneW6.name: Warped_Weapon_Upgrade_Stone
item:StoneW6.description: Drag onto any Weapon to apply. Success Chance; 50% Uses up 1 item slots. WARNING:Slots are used up even if the Upgrade fails!

item:ExpBalloon1.name: Small_Experience_Balloon
item:ExpBalloon1.description: Hold down to gain EXP in the skill that's displayed in the corner of your screen. If you're in a town, you will gain EXP in the town skill. The amount of EXP you get is based on your skill's Lv.

item:Bullet.name: Bullet
item:Bullet.description: Increases Weapon Power by 1. 15% chance to be consumed every time you defeat a monster. Must be equipped in a Food Slot to give its bonus.

item:EquipmentStatues1.name: Power_Statue
item:EquipmentStatues1.description: A stone statue sculpted in the likeness of an absolute unit. Give this to the Statue Man in return for some bonus stats.

item:Quest20.name: Signed_Arrest_Warrant
item:Quest20.description: That's weird, Bandit Bob's signature looks an awful lot like yours...

item:PremiumGem.name: Gem
item:PremiumGem.description: Hold down to add these gems to your account. You can then spend them in the Gem Shop!

item:NPCtoken16.name: Bandit_Bob_Token
item:NPCtoken16.description: Proof that you completed all of Bandit Bob's quests! Hold down to add to your token bag found in Storage Info. DONT SELL THIS ITEM

item:Quest45.name: Sesame_Seed
item:Quest45.description: The key to Bandit Bob's Party Dungeon! No not that dungeon... you're thinking of Snakenhotep's Dungeon, this one's for Bandit Bob's dungeon. So yea, this is worthless.

pageProps.seoDescription: Bandit Bob is a Legends of Idleon NPC: quest reward, 4 quests.
